 end
 end

 D2 --> A2 --> MIX
 end

 end

 subgraph OUT[\"Output\"]
 DAC[\"DAC\"]
 AMP[\"Amplifier\"]
 SPK[\"Transducers\"]

 end

 subgraph PWR[\"Power and Clock\"]
 PMIC[\"PMIC\"]
 CLK[\"Audio Clock\"]
 end

 BLE -->|\"Stream A\"| BA
 BLE -->|\"Stream B\"| BB
 BLE <-->|\"HCI\"| STACK
 CPU --- FLASH
 CPU --- RAM
 CPU -.->|\"Volume\"| MIX
 BA --> D1
 BB --> D2
 MIX --> DAC
 ENC -->|\"Mic\"| BLE
 CLK -->|\"Audio clock\"| DAC
 CLK -.->|\"Reference\"| A1
 CLK -.->|\"Reference\"| A2
